patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: てしまう after a verb says the thing happens completely, often to your regret, and ちゃう is its shortened spoken form. なっちゃう = 'end up becoming'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に なる means to become that way. Here いやに なる is slurred into やんなる. やんなっちゃう = 'I get totally fed up'.
